meaning: Take further action or find out more about an earlier matter.
arabicMeaning: يتابع موضوعًا سابقًا باتخاذ إجراء إضافي أو طلب مزيد من المعلومات.
example: We sent the proposal last week. I will follow up on it tomorrow and ask whether the client needs more information.
learnerPurpose: Take professional action after earlier contact
pattern: follow something up; follow up on something; follow something up with a call or email
register: Professional; transitive or follow up on; separable
frequencyEvidence: Cambridge labels the take-further-action sense B2 and includes Business English evidence. Oxford confirms the professional pattern but tags Working life C1; WordPix presents it as an optional B2–C1 extension; no numeric frequency claim.

check.question: What will the speaker do tomorrow?
check.expectedAnswer: Take further action on the proposal.
check.explanation: The proposal was sent earlier; the speaker will ask whether the client needs more information.
